comment: Overrides for scripts/swiftpm-notices.py (macOS app). Keys under packages are SwiftPM identities from MacDring.xcodeproj's Package.resolved. Every entry needs a reason. Every resolved pin is included, linked or not, so no notice goes missing when a product starts using one.
